hooks.command: bash -c 'TID="${OPENCLAUDE_THREAD_ID:-0}"; TODAY=$(date +%Y-%m-%d); echo "=== LONG-TERM MEMORY ==="; cat memory/MEMORY.md 2>/dev/null || echo "(no long-term memory yet)"; echo; echo "=== TODAY DAILY LOGS (t$TID/$TODAY) ==="; LOGDIR="memory/t$TID/$TODAY"; if [ -d "$LOGDIR" ]; then for f in "$LOGDIR"/*.md; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "--- $(basename "$f") ---" && cat "$f" && echo; done; else echo "(no daily logs today yet)"; fi; echo; echo "[Save daily logs to memory/t$TID/$TODAY/]"; echo "[Topic thread ID: $TID]"'
